moodys.citation_text: No Moody's. Fitch sole active rater.

fitch.citation_text: Universe v2: '2024-01: Fitch BB- with negative outlook' — implies BB- already in place at year-end 2022. Already sub-IG entering window.

rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Universe v2 file documents 2024-01 BB- negative.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: BB- affirmed; outlook revised stable from negative
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Universe v2 file: '2025-01: Fitch affirmed BB- with outlook revised to stable'.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: BB- -> CCC (multi-notch; reportedly via B- intermediate)
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Persistent operating challenges; continued negative cash flow generation in FY25; operating EBITDA -4.2% and EBITDA -3.7%; only 14 days cash on hand as of Sept. 30, 2025; cash-to-adjusted debt 20.3%.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch: 'two-notch downgrade to CCC from B- reflects RWHS's persistent operating challenges that led to continued negative cash flow generation in FY25'. Also: 'RWHS had only 14.0 days cash on hand (DCOH) as of Sept. 30, 2025'. NOTE: Dec 2025 action is AFTER window end 2025-03-31.

fitch.citation_text: Jan 2025 BB- stable in effect at window end. Subsequent Dec 2025 downgrade to CCC falls AFTER window end.

outcome_class_rationale: Within 2023-Q1 to 2025-Q1 window, only action was Jan 2025 outlook revision from negative to stable (no rating change). Subsequent multi-notch downgrade to CCC occurred Dec 2025 — AFTER the window ends. Within window: AFFIRM (positive_outlook_movement). Note: RWHS was already sub-IG entering window so this is not a fallen-angel-within-window observation; it's a stable-distressed observation.

new_actions.rationale: Operating EBITDA negative 4.2% YTD Sept 30, 2025 (vs -7.2% FY2024) — labeled 'very weak' though improving. Plan to generate positive operating cash flow in FY2026 via Nebraska Medicaid Directed Payment Program.
